name: Methylmethaqualone
summary: A more potent analogue of methaqualone with a short duration. The drug is suspected to be  neurotoxic. The drug is reported to have proconvulsive effects.
advisory: The drug is reported to have caused a high amount of seizures, caution is strongly recommended.
doseBasis: NOTE: The drug is reported to have caused a high amount of seizures, caution is strongly recommended.

pharmacology.text: Methylmethaqualone (MMQ) is a quinazolinone and an analogue of methaqualone that has similar sedative and hypnotic properties to its parent compound (resulting from its agonist activity at the β subtype of the GABAA receptor) and is around 3 times as potent in animal models.

uses.text: It would appear that this compound was sold on the black market in Germany as a designer drug analogue of methaqualone.

summaryZh: 甲基甲喹酮（英語：Methylmethaqualone，簡稱MMQ）或稱甲基安眠酮，是一種喹唑啉酮和甲喹酮的類似物，具有與其母體化合物相似的鎮靜和催眠特性（源於其對GABAA受體β亞型的激動劑活性），在動物模型中的效力約為其3倍。甲基甲喹酮與甲喹酮的區別在於苯環上的4-甲基化。
summaryZhHans: 甲基甲喹酮（英语：Methylmethaqualone，简称MMQ）或称甲基安眠酮，是一种喹唑啉酮和甲喹酮的类似物，具有与其母体化合物相似的镇静和催眠特性（源于其对GABAA受体β亚型的激动剂活性），在动物模型中的效力约为其3倍。甲基甲喹酮与甲喹酮的区别在于苯环上的4-甲基化。
